content.value: API and Contracts is the wire boundary of Barkpark — the versioned HTTP surface every other surface and SDK speaks to.

The HTTP API v1 is the stable JSON interface served by the Phoenix API. Reads go through query endpoints; writes go through a Mutation, which stages changes against a Perspective and lands them on a Dataset. Access is gated by Auth and Tokens — tier-keyed bearer tokens that also drive existence-hiding so unauthorized callers can't probe private schemas.

) is the self-describing contract that lets the bp CLI, Go TUI, and JS SDK configure themselves at runtime. Search Intelligence is the query-side contract for Search — the same endpoint shape whether Postgres Search or the Indx Engine answers.

After a Mutation, Webhooks fire to notify subscribers, and Cache Revalidation tells the Web Demo (and any consumer) to drop stale pages. This is the contract that keeps "headless" honest: one write, many surfaces, all consistent.
